author: Mirco
name: Shared-MLP Deep Attention (MLX)
blurb: ALBERT-style shared MLP across all 16 transformer layers — each layer has unique attention but shares a single 3x-expanded MLP. Saves ~9M params vs per-layer MLPs, enabling 16 layers (vs 9 baseline) within similar budget. 14.7M params, ~9.8 MB compressed.
